mcp.instructions: ADR Intelligence server. Human-owned ADR fields (title, context, decision, rationale, alternatives, consequences, status, approvers, approval result, notes, supersession) are never changed by analysis: use adr_propose_change and let a human approve with adr_approve_change. Analysis results (technologies, drift, contradictions, safety findings) are advisory and carry confidence and provenance. Upload files with file_upload_request + a direct PUT, then file_register_upload. Long-running work returns a job id: poll analysis_job_get.
